rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Cuesta's records docs/program_requirements_harvest_lessons.md, S741, holds by key (Cuesta 43053 and 41744) held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.pair_read_as_alternatives: The catalog prints two courses taken together as one option, and the record reads them as separate alternatives, so its low end falls short of the printed total.

records.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
records.words: AVMT 110 (5 units) may be replaced by the pair AVMT 110A AND AVMT 110B (2.5 units each); likewise AVMT 120 by AVMT 120A AND AVMT 120B. The alternatives are recorded on one entry but must be taken together, not either one alone.

program.section_heading: AVIATION MECHANIC - POWERPLANT - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Remove and install a fuel nozzle in a turbine engine.
Perform engine inspection requirement in compliance with 14 CFR Part 43 and 14 CFR Part 91.
Troubleshoot an engine oil temperature/pressure instrument system and perform necessary repairs to make system operable.
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with fire protection system extinguishing agents.
Inspect engine Perform inspection of aircraft reciprocating engine and determine airworthiness.

live_run_proof.how: the hosting API's commits by path on main

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
